method: For each of 73 main commits, compare additions with latest main, excluding later superseded additions; compare exact final main blobs when possible, otherwise verify surviving additions as whitespace-normalized substrings in mapped real packages. Imports/re-exports are relocated and excluded from line-substring matching; fragments under 12 non-whitespace characters are ignored. Explicit async/plugin-package transformations are asserted separately. Detailed source/target paths and counts retained per commit.
